rules.build:
KERNEL_ARCH="`bh_kernel_arch_for_target $AELTRA_HOST_TYPE`"
cd $AELTRA_SOURCE_DIR make SHELL=/bin/sh ARCH="$KERNEL_ARCH" headers
rules.install:
cd $AELTRA_SOURCE_DIR find usr/include -name '.*' -delete rm usr/include/Makefile
mkdir -p "$AELTRA_INSTALL_DIR/$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX/include" cp -va usr/include/* "$AELTRA_INSTALL_DIR/$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX/include"
